symptom: Para 合并在 post-dispatch 门禁失败（如 PR #765 docker-build-fhd-api）后，自维护循环仍把 para_merge_conflict 记为 resume_from_clean_baseline=true，迫使从干净基线全量重做已在拒绝分支上的生产修复。

executable_template.applicability_check: Loop memory open_items show para_merge_conflict with detail starting with post-dispatch-check-failed while the rejected branch already contains the intended fix and main may have merged it separately.
executable_template.patch_strategy: Detect post-dispatch-check-failed in merge_conflict detail, set resume_from_clean_baseline=false so resume enables continue_existing_code_task, and branch-specific external merge remediation prompt text.
executable_template.rollback_plan: Restore unconditional resume_from_clean_baseline=true for all para_merge_conflict items and revert remediation prompt to clean-base-only instructions.
